name: companion
description: Seamless Study-OS Jupyter workflow for VS Code, Antigravity & Cursor: 1-click open with cursor in code cell, automatic BI CSV dataset linking, per-subpart AI-Par timers, top-of-cell CodeLens HUD, cell execution tracking & 1-click completion sync to Study-OS.

commands.title: Study-OS: Finish Exercise & Sync to Study-OS
Study-OS: Start AI-Par Timer for Active Notebook

studyOs.practiceFolder.description: Optional custom folder for Study-OS Jupyter practice notebooks (.ipynb). Leave empty to auto-detect your active workspace or BI Canvas-Archive Files folder.

studyOs.webUrl.description: Study-OS web URL used when syncing completed exercises back to Study-OS.

studyOs.idlePauseMinutes.description: Automatically pause the AI-Par timer after this many minutes without typing or executing cells (0 to disable).
